name: AgInputBookingDesk
tagline: Seed, fertiliser and crop protection prepay bookings – early-order discounts, deposits, stock allocation and delivery scheduling in one app.
description: A complete ag-retail booking desk for Power Apps and Power Pages. Book growers' season inputs with automatic early-order, volume-tier, deal and prepay discounts, take deposits and payments, allocate scarce stock first-paid / first-booked, schedule deliveries within each branch's daily drop capacity and let growers send booking requests from a self-service order desk.
features: Early-order windows, volume tiers, deal and prepay discounts with a maximum cap
Deposits, payments and automatic Booked → Prepaid
Auto-allocation of short stock: paid in full → deposit paid → earliest booking
Delivery week board with branch drops-per-day capacity and lead time
Status rules for confirm, allocate, schedule, deliver (short deliveries), hold and cancel (refunds)
Multi-line order desk with live price, deposit and tier preview
Grower accounts with volume tier progress and statements
Search, 16 quick filters, filter drawer, grouping, sorting, bulk actions, CSV export, undo
Demo mode, phone layout with bottom view bar, keyboard and screen-reader support
